description: This file implements the TimeZoneSupport class, which manages timezone updates by monitoring a timezone file, reading its contents, and updating environment variables accordingly.

classes.name: TimeZoneSupport
classes.description: A class that monitors a timezone file for changes and updates the system timezone environment variable accordingly.

methods.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from a string.
